verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships official error-reporting SDKs for more than 50 platforms. The first-party bugsnag-js repo covers browser, Node.js and React Native, with framework plugins and a programmatic `Bugsnag.notify()` API. Newer SDK APIs (custom session windows, iOS appHangCallback) show active development, and a hands-on community report confirms official iOS, Ruby, Node and Android libraries are quick to integrate. Missing for 10: an official client SDK for the Data Access API (only an OpenAPI spec is evidenced, so programmatic data access means raw HTTP), and recent independent corroboration of SDK developer experience.
